eras.title: Doorways through Pueblo Bonito
eras.caption: At Pueblo Bonito, a sequence of small doorways leads through the surviving rooms of a Chacoan great house. Thin sandstone courses, thick walls and traces of upper floors show the skill of its Ancestral Pueblo builders.

eras.title: The great house from the rim
eras.caption: From the canyon rim, Pueblo Bonito's curved outer wall encloses a dense arrangement of rooms, plazas and circular kivas. The wider view reveals the scale and planning of this Ancestral Pueblo great house, set against the open floor of Chaco Canyon.
